'''April 2001 Madrid tournament (first event)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 7 April 2001. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2046">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-ithor-madrid-04-07-01d2046/ ithor-madrid-04-07-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 9 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-ithor-madrid-04-07-01d2046/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
